bio: Enzo Carminati First-Year Social Committee Oak Yard Hey y'all! My name is Enzo Carminati and I'm from the Greater Boston area. I live in Canaday (no it's not that bad) and I plan to concentrate in Computer Science and Economics. Outside of the FYSC, you can find me playing on the Harvard Ultimate Frisbee team, playing pool or doing everything but work in Cabot. Can't wait to help build our vibrant community on campus through FYSC! Please feel free to approach me about anything, I'd be happy to help and hear your opinions!
